question: A class of 60 students has an average score of 75. If 5 new students are added and the class average increases by 1, what is the average score of the 5 new students?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average of new entrants = Old Average + [(Total Final Students × Increase in Average) ÷ Number of New Students]

⇒ Average = 75 + [(65 × 1) ÷ 5]

⇒ Average = 75 + (65 ÷ 5)

⇒ Average = 75 + 13 = 88

**∴ The correct answer is 88 marks.**

**Given:**

Initial number of students = 60

Initial average score = 75

New students added = 5

**Formula Used:**

Total Sum = Average × Number of items
